Circular Communication to Commissioners and Contracting Governments

<br>

IWC.CCG.[INSERT NUMBER]  
c.c. Accredited observers to the IWC

<br>

**Request for catch data and infractions reports for the `r lubridate::year(Sys.Date()) - 1` season**

</center>

<br>

This Circular invites Contracting Governments to submit information on catches and reports of any infractions for the **`r lubridate::year(Sys.Date()) - 1`** season to the Secretariat by **`r format(Sys.Date()+30, "%d %B %Y")`**.

<br>

Article IX.4 of the International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling (1946) states that Contracting Governments shall transmit to the Commission full details of each infraction including a statement of measures taken and penalties imposed.

<br>

All data and information received will be compiled by the Secretariat and made available to the next meeting of the Commission’s Infractions Sub-committee.

<br>

The Infractions Sub-committee has adopted a form and checklist for reporting infractions, including reporting details of any infractions committed in previous years that remain unresolved. The form is available [here](https://archive.iwc.int/?r=22529) and the checklist is available [here](https://archive.iwc.int/?r=22528). 

<br>

While the use of the form is not compulsory, it is indicative of the required information. Contracting Governments must fulfil their reporting obligations under Article IX.4 of the Convention.

<br>

Should you have any questions, please contact the Statistics and Modelling Department of the Secretariat at [statistics@iwc.int](mailto:statistics@iwc.int).

<br>
